Container.Name: magazine-sorter
Container.Overview: Conservative magazine PDF organizer with Dry Run, Review, OCR, Apply, History and safe Undo.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent settings, publication profiles, Dry Run state and History.

Config.Name: Input
Config.Description: Folder containing source magazines. The application uses /input internally.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Komga library destination. The application uses /library internally.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used for file operations. Unraid default nobody is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used for file operations. Unraid default users group is 100.

Config.Name: OCR backend
Config.Description: Use the Tesseract installation bundled in the image.
